% Checks cases the fix must not break: an article with sectsty and a
% sans-serif \allsectionsfont, whose part has no \parttitlefont to read.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{sectsty}
\allsectionsfont{\sffamily}
\begin{document}
\part{First part}
\section{A section with \emph{italic}}
Text in \emph{italic} with a footnote.\footnote{The footnote text.}
\part*{An unnumbered part}
Text after the unnumbered part.
\end{document}
